title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
Observe one X distributed as Bernoulli(theta), with theta in [0,1]. Let T:{0,1}->R be any estimator.
Then inf_T sup_{theta in [0,1]} E_theta|T(X)-theta| >= 1/16.
Proof. Choose theta_a=-1/4 and theta_b=1/4; both belong to the parameter space and their Bernoulli laws have total variation distance 1/2.
Classify T(X) by the midpoint zero. On a classification error, absolute estimation error is at least 1/4.
The sum of the two classification error probabilities is at least 1-TV=1/2.
Thus the maximum of the two risks is at least (1/4)(1/2)(1/2)=1/16, proving the lower bound.
